title: Establish the Theurgy Laboratory
description: Theurgy concerns matter, minerals, replication, and transmutation—not potion brewing with a more impressive vocabulary. Bring its material-processing apparatus into practical use. The native liquefaction-cauldron milestone is enough to establish the Tower facility; the rest of Theurgy remains its own progression.
description_completed: The Dark Tower's Theurgy facility is operational. Further transmutation and material mastery remain outside Tower Restoration.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

objectives.name: Bring a Liquefaction Cauldron into Theurgy progression
